findings.summary: T16 reuses PR C's plan record scoped to T17–T25, which excludes T16 and therefore fails the plan-scope predicate; require a plan re-review covering T16 before the activation PR.

disposition.reason: Task 16 Step 2's record-reuse wording is stale on main since #104 changed the plan blob; this PR carries this record (scope T16,T24) instead of reusing the T26-scoped one

findings.summary: Closing and reopening a PR whose head predates the workflow does not supply the checker script that the workflow executes from its head checkout, so grandfathering cannot succeed without an additional branch-update or trusted-checker step; T24 inherits this problem.

disposition.reason: Task 16 Step 3's close/reopen path is in the plan on main; for #65 and #69 (heads without the checker) Step 3 updates the branch from main instead
